title: the node_address tool packs a 16-bit table tag over a 48-bit row into one signed bigint
intention: One codec for the librarian's address: pack(tag,row) -> signed int64, unpack back, a tag registry file (nodes 1, lists 2, links 3, blobs 4), and Ref(address, gen); every value off its bits refused naming the field.
why: Akien, Q#108 (outline 4.3.1.5.1.6): every reference is one 64-bit integer, top 16 bits the table tag, low 48 the row; every pointer a direct row fetch. Six owners' leaf tables and the librarian's bus verbs carry addresses, so the codec is a published tool (RULE 1).
traces_to: Law 1 (an address is a direct row fetch, never re-derived); Law 7 (off-bits values refused loudly); RULE 1.
how: New tool cairn/tools/node_address: node_address.py (pack/unpack/tag_of/row_of/registry/tag_for/name_for/Ref/AddressRefused), tags.json, __init__.py re-export, charter. Two's-complement packing so tags >= 0x8000 fit postgres bigint, measured by a bigint tooth over store.scratch.

out: every other component; the trees tool's use of the codec is 06db586bedfd

measured.saw: postgres bigint is signed: an unsigned pack of tag >= 0x8000 exceeds 2^63-1; the two's-complement pack round-trips through a bigint column
measured.how: proof tooth 3 over store.scratch on akiendelllinux, 5/5 green at d4ea67d44

outcomes.claim: every (tag,row) pair at the edges (tag 1, 0x7FFF, 0x8000, 0xFFFF; row 1, 2^48-1) round-trips and no two pairs pack to one address
tag 0, tag > 0xFFFF, row 0, row >= 2^48, a bool or non-int, and address 0 are refused with AddressRefused naming the field
every packed address, sign-bit tags included, is written to and read back unchanged from a postgres bigint column
the registry names nodes 1, lists 2, links 3, blobs 4, each tag once, and an unknown name or tag is refused
a Ref under another gen is not equal to the original; a negative or non-int gen is refused

outcomes.text: the codec and the registry, signed two's-complement pack.
the tool's charter, born through the artifact door.
the proof, one tooth per clause; the bigint tooth over store.scratch.
